scope: Independent upstream-rebase and whole-history-rewrite counters, unbounded fork commit counts, and amendment-safe build identities

contracts.behavior: UPSTREAM-forkREBASES.HISTORY_REWRITES.COMMITS-BUILD keeps independent explicit rebase/rewrite counts, excludes upstream from the full first-parent commit count, never carries or caps that count, preserves Git-free provenance and records validated upgrade/rewrite events without changing HEAD.

Each native build reserves a locked per-source-commit number; new commits and amendments reset to zero while dirty edits and label-only changes continue. Parallel output directories share state; corrupt counters cannot publish a replacement header. Dry runs allocate nothing.

CLI, About and read-only tmux-mosh inventory report UPSTREAM-forkX.Y.Z-N without hashes, dirty text or a second binary hash suffix. Preserve GNU ELF build IDs for local stale-build checks. Rebuilds do not restart existing desktop windows.
tests: Meson terminal-build-monitor and isolated input/clipboard suites

environments.versioning: Private Git main histories, temporary Meson builds and parallel isolated output directories
environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG runtime/config/cache/data, Xvfb and D-Bus; no user windows restarted

previous_scheme_verification.activation: Existing ~/.local/bin symlink resolves to rebuilt build/terminal/xfce4-terminal. No user windows or tmux/Mosh sessions restarted; no commits or pushes.
previous_scheme_verification.note: Preserved historical evidence for the superseded decimal/cumulative scheme, not a current verification claim.
